name: OT - Claroty CTD alert (suppressed by asset and signature)
description: Turns Claroty CTD alerts ingested through the Claroty CTD integration into Elastic detection alerts, grouping repeated identical alerts (same source, same destination asset and same Claroty alert name; a different source breaks out as its own alert) into a single alert with a suppressed-document count for 4 hours. Intended to keep one contextualised item per asset and signature for analyst triage.
false_positives: Scheduled maintenance by a known-good engineering workstation (see ot-assets: asset.known_good and asset.maintenance_window).
note:
Triage: open the Asset and Firewall Context dashboard for the destination asset, confirm known_good and maintenance window in the asset metadata, confirm the FortiGate rule hit (policy ENG-to-PLC-S7) and the authorised engineer logon on the source workstation. Close the case as a false positive if all match.

MITRE ATT&CK for ICS: PLC Program Download maps to T0843 (Program Download); S7 read/scan maps to T0846 (Remote System Discovery). Kibana rule threat mapping covers Enterprise ATT&CK only, so ICS techniques are carried as tags and references. Change management: an unexpected program download to a Level 1 controller is a change-control event.
